title: Final casino meeting with Dennis Mariani

as_told.title: Gene Huff's view of Lazar approaching Dennis at the casino

plain: This story comes from Bob Lazar, a man known for claims about secret work he says he did in the Nevada desert, and it is set in a Las Vegas casino in 1989. Lazar says he went to meet a man named Dennis Mariani there. He says he kept saying, "Dennis, I'm here, what do you want?" but Mariani never even looked up at him. Lazar says he walked over to his friend Gene Huff, and when the two of them turned back around, Mariani was gone. The story is also told on the same podcast episode, hosted by Jesse Michels, by a guest named Luigi, who says he heard it from Gene Huff. In Luigi's version, Mariani was a blonde, military-looking man who did not even look at Lazar while Lazar talked to him. Why anyone tells it: if true, it would suggest Lazar was being watched or handled by people he could not identify.
